entities.name: King Mihai I University of Life Sciences of Timisoara
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The King Mihai I University of Life Sciences, known until 2022 as the University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine of Banat, is a public university in Timișoara, Romania, which specializes in life sciences and veterinary medicine. It was named in honor of King Michael I of Romania.
